competences.description: Attacks the enemy target and recovers the HP of an ally with the lowest HP ratio by 15%.
Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects granted on them and provokes for 1 turn with a 50% chance each.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns when you attack the enemy on your turn and inflicts Continuous Damage to the enemy target for 2 turns when you're attacked by a target during the enemy's turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Stacks 1 totem whenever you're attacked by a target during the enemy's turn or use a skill during your turn. Becomes able to use the [Volcanic Tribe Totem] skill when you stack 3 totems. Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and decreases the HP by 5% per harmful effect granted when you use the skill. Up to 10% is applied to the boss.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
